entry.title: New: Resolution 395 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPROVES LEGISLATIVE PROPOSALS AND PRIORITIES FOR INCLUSION IN THE 2026 HAWAIʻI STATE ASSOCIATION OF COUNTIES LEGISLATIVE PACKAGE

Includes proposals relating to emergency medical services and opioid use disorder treatment, mixed-use development relating to housing, cesspools, Department of Education recreational facilities, the Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact, tobacco products, the repeal of amendments to Section 201H-38 relating to housing, family, firearms, gun violence prevention, water pollution, general excise tax, conveyance tax, and housing for State and County employees

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 395-25 - 11/19/25
